title: Decision: hub accepts -11 §5.1 updates to app_components, safe_aad, content_media_types; checks frank_aad before merge
description: Chosen by Mark 2026-11-04 (alternative 'keep refusing as room policy' rejected). mls-extensions-11 §5.1 makes AppDataUpdate the way to change app_components (0x0001), safe_aad (0x0002) and content_media_types (0x0003). The hub accepts such updates instead of refusing them as UnknownComponent, and before merging checks the resulting GroupContext still satisfies decision mimid-1wgh.6.74's requirement (frank_aad 0x0020 required in safe_aad, etc.), refusing the Commit otherwise. Revises .6.74's invariant 'no Commit can change safe_aad' to 'no Commit can leave the room without the required Safe AAD'.
